comment: The function runs beside the database, not beside the visitor.
Vercel defaults to iad1 (Washington). The database is in ap-southeast-1
(Singapore), so every query crossed the Pacific: endpoints issuing many
sequential queries took three to nine seconds while /health, which
touches nothing, answered in 0.3. Static files are served from every
region regardless, so the shell still arrives from the Mumbai edge.
Singapore is also the closer of the two to a panel in India.

app.buildCommand: cd web && npm ci && npm run build
